candidate_observations.address: Sports Direct, 638 High Road, Tottenham, London
observed_facts: The freehold produces £175,000 p.a. under a five-year lease from 11 December 2025.
The tenant can break on 11 December 2028; if the break is not exercised, a three-month rent-free period follows.
Company 03406347 changed its legal name from Sportsdirect.com Retail Limited to Frasers Group Trading Limited on 30 March 2026.
Upper and remaining parts are long-let to Metropolitan Housing Trust at peppercorn.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £175,000 rent was not projected beyond the December 2028 break, the later rent-free period was preserved and peppercorn upper parts were not treated as income.

observed_facts: The former car showroom and workshop is offered with vacant possession.
The freehold comprises three buildings, approximately 12,604 sq ft on a 1.45-acre site.
Marketing describes asset-management or development potential but does not establish a planning permission.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No current rent, development value or planning consent was inferred.

observed_facts: The vacant former NatWest bank is a 10,278 sq ft freehold with approximately 16 parking spaces.
The sale remains conditional and subject to seller confirmation.
Both 49 South Street and 50 South Street have separate Grade II entries in the National Heritage List.
Residential conversion is marketed only subject to planning and Listed Building consent.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No income, unconditional sale, residential permission or conversion value was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Tesco and Flats, 58–60 Calverton Road, Luton
observed_facts: The page headline states £87,030 p.a., while the tenancy schedule totals £87,090 p.a.
The schedule comprises £75,000 Tesco rent, a £12,000 annualised AST and three £30 residential ground rents.
The Tesco lease has reviews in 2029 and 2034 and a tenant break on 26 August 2034.
Tesco Stores Limited, company 00519500, is active.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £60 conflict was preserved, mixed income was not presented as one institutional covenant and no reviewed rent was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: 1–6 Silver Court, Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire
observed_facts: The final £1,895,000 sale supersedes the pre-auction guide.
The official addendum excludes Units 1–2, corrects the property to two office buildings and approximately 1.07 hectares, and updates the Quantum Care terms with a September 2030 break.
The £324,057 headline includes £60,000 from a Sidel lease described as holding over and £41,000 from a Sanctuary lease whose stated term ended on 23 July 2026.
The schedule also records 10,363 sq ft of vacant accommodation.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Excluded units were not counted, holding-over or expired income was not projected as secure current income and vacant space was not assigned rent.

candidate_observations.address: Unit 3c, St Mary's Row / Oxford Road, Moseley, Birmingham
observed_facts: The virtual-freehold unit produces £21,000 p.a. under a ten-year lease from 21 February 2025.
The tenant can break on 21 February 2030.
Cuppa Chaii Limited, company 15816328, is active; the displayed confirmation-statement due date had passed while the register still showed the prior statement.
The superior head rent is £1 p.a.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £21,000 rent was not projected to 2035, statutory filing timing was not treated as property default and the £1 head rent remained a liability.

candidate_observations.address: Unit 3b, St Mary's Row / Oxford Road, Moseley, Birmingham
observed_facts: The final £135,000 result supersedes the property page's stale Available status and £120,000 guide.
The £12,000 p.a. lease to an individual trading as Village Reformer runs from 3 September 2025 to 2 September 2030.
The virtual-freehold interest carries £1 p.a. head rent.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The individual covenant was not converted into a company identity, the rent was not extended beyond September 2030 and the £1 head rent was not treated as income.

candidate_observations.address: 19 Silverburn Place, Bridge of Don Industrial Estate, Aberdeen
observed_facts: The 12,825 sq ft office, workshop and laboratory property is offered with vacant possession.
The leasehold interest runs to 12 November 2072.
The current £32,970 p.a. figure is head rent payable under the superior lease, not occupational income.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The head rent was recorded as a liability, no occupational income was invented and no development or planning value was inferred.
